sceneDescription: Cɛmancɛ bɛ nin navigatɔrɔ in ka Helia node jira. Node verts jɛmanw bɛ tali kɛ navigatɔrɔn na sisan ani layini bɛ u cɛmancɛ la. Violet nodes sɔrɔla browser routing fɛ nka u tɛ ɲɔgɔn sɔrɔ. Sanu node ye ɲɔgɔndan dafalenw ye minnu bɛ fɔ sigida Kubo jinɛ danfaralen fɛ; u tɛ navigatɔrɔn ɲɔgɔndanw ye wa layini tɛ u la ka taa nin santiri in na. Slate dolow salenw bɛ tariku min ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ tigɛlen don, o mara, wa u ka dalilu sira bɛ bɔ yen jɛɲɔgɔnya tigɛlen kɔfɛ dɔrɔn. Yɔrɔjan ka bɔ cɛmancɛ kartiw la minnu bɛ latɛmɛni suman; ɲɔgɔndan sumanibaliw bɛ kɛnɛma-yɔrɔ Minɛ, ani angle groups (kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la) bolifɛn kɔlɔsilen. Dolow minnu bɛ kɔkanna masiri, olu tɛ u filankuruw jira. Kɛnɛma-yɔrɔ min ka dɔgɔ, o bɛ Kubo foro min donna jamana kɔnɔ, o taamasiyɛn wa a tɛ jɛɲɔgɔnya ye. Relay edge bɛ bɔ dɔrɔn ni relay ID bɛ yen peer set kɔlɔsilen kɔnɔ; topidiya min bɛ kɛ ni ɲɔgɔndan ye, o tɛ jate abada. Baara kɛ ni peer explorer ye walasa ka kunnafoni kelenw sɔrɔ sɛbɛnni cogo la.
